name: Quality Control
nameTh: ควบคุมคุณภาพ
description: ISO 9001-friendly quality control: inspection plans per item and stage (incoming, in-process, final) with sampling and measured / pass-fail / visual checkpoints, inspections with automatic pass / fail / conditional verdicts, non-conformance reports (NCR) with 5-Why root cause and disposition, corrective actions with due dates and verification, and pass-rate / defect / supplier-quality reports. Incoming inspections are queued automatically when Purchasing receives goods, final inspections when Production completes an order.
